1942-10-01.commanding_officer: H. O. Parish, Lt. Comdr., U.S.N.

watches.text: Moored fore and aft to buoys in Chernofski Harbor, Alaska, in 11 fathoms of water. Auxiliary boiler in use for auxiliary purposes. Ships present: various units of Task Force plus U.S. Coast Guard vessels and District craft. S.O.P.A. in U.S.S. Williamson (AVD-27).
extracted_events: Moored fore & aft to buoys in 11 fathoms, Chernofski Harbor
Auxiliary boiler online; SOPA in USS Williamson (AVD-27)

watches.text: Moored as before. Routine harbor security watches maintained.
extracted_events: Routine harbor security watch; barometer falling rapidly (-0.18 inHg)

watches.text: Moored as before. 0900 Quarters for muster and daily inspection of magazines and smokeless powder samples; conditions normal. Prepared deck lines and fenders for fueling evolution.
extracted_events: 0900 Quarters for muster; daily magazine & powder sample inspection normal

watches.text: Moored as before. 1315 Lighted fires under #1 and #2 boilers. 1335 Cut in #1 and #2 boilers on main steam line. 1343 Cast off from mooring buoys, underway on various courses and speeds maneuvering to go alongside U.S. Navy Tanker U.S.S. Brazos. 1445 Moored starboard side to U.S.S. Brazos; commenced fueling. Draft before fueling: 9' 3" forward, 12' 0" aft.
extracted_events: 1315 Lighted fires under Boilers #1 & #2; 1343 Underway from mooring buoys
1445 Moored starboard side to USS Brazos; commenced fueling (Draft 9'3" fwd, 12'0" aft)

watches.text: Moored starboard side to U.S. Navy Tanker U.S.S. Brazos, fueling in progress. 1635 Completed fueling, having received on board 43,638 gallons of Bunker 'B' fuel oil at temperature 63°F. Draft after fueling: 10' 6" forward, 12' 3" aft. 1650 Cast off from tanker, maneuvering to mooring buoys. 1712 Moored fore and aft to buoys. 1735 Secured #1 and #2 boilers.
extracted_events: 1635 Completed fueling: Received 43,638 gals Bunker 'B' fuel oil at 63°F (Matches Fuel Table)
Draft after fueling: 10'6" fwd (+15 in), 12'3" aft (+3 in)
1712 Re-moored fore & aft to buoys; 1735 Secured Boilers #1 & #2

watches.text: Moored as before. Auxiliary boiler in use. Harbor security watches maintained.
extracted_events: Moored as before; auxiliary boiler in use

1942-10-02.commanding_officer: H. O. Parish, Lt. Comdr., U.S.N.

watches.text: Moored fore and aft to buoys in Chernofski Harbor, Alaska, in 11 fathoms of water. Auxiliary boiler in use.
extracted_events: Moored fore & aft in 11 fathoms; auxiliary boiler in use

watches.text: Moored as before. 0730 Lighted fires under #1 and #2 boilers; tested main steering gear and engine order telegraphs.
extracted_events: 0730 Lighted fires under Boilers #1 & #2; tested steering gear

watches.text: 0815 Underway in accordance with orders. 1030 Held Captain's Mast. By order of the Commanding Officer: McASEY, W. J., Sea1c, U.S.N., was awarded five (5) days solitary confinement on bread and water for disobedience of orders; BAKER, H. H., Sea2c, U.S.N., was awarded five (5) hours extra police duties. Made daily inspection of magazines and smokeless powder samples (Max 63°F, Min 55°F).
extracted_events: Captain's Mast: McASEY, W. J. (Sea1c) — 5 days solitary confinement on bread & water
Captain's Mast: BAKER, H. H. (Sea2c) — 5 hours extra police duties

watches.text: [Superseded entry struck out at bottom of Page 6 and continued on Page 7] Steaming as before on various courses approaching Chernofski Harbor. 1420 Entered harbor channel; 1445 Moored fore and aft to mooring buoys in Chernofski Harbor in 11 fathoms of water.
extracted_events: Superseded 12-16 strikeout on Page 6 stitched to full 12-16 watch on Continuation Page 7
1445 Moored fore & aft to buoys in Chernofski Harbor

watches.text: Moored as before in Chernofski Harbor. Shifted fuel and fresh water ballast; routine security watches maintained.
extracted_events: Moored in Chernofski Harbor; security watches maintained
